subject: general
question: Men's FIH Hockey World Cup-2023 was held in which of the following states in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Odisha.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Men's FIH Hockey World Cup-2023 **was held in the state of** Odisha in India.**
 
• The tournament was organized by the **International Hockey Federation (FIH).**
 
• The event took place at the** Kalinga Stadium in Bhubaneswar,** Odisha.
 
• **Sixteen teams** from around the world participated in the tournament.
 
• This was the **second time** that Odisha hosted the Men's Hockey World Cup, the first being in** 2018.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Maharashtra** has hosted several international sports events such as the **Indian Premier League (IPL) **and the **Commonwealth Youth Games.**
 
• **Jharkhand** has hosted several national level hockey tournaments.
 
 
• Ranchi was the home of the **city-based Ranchi Rays** and hosted multiple Hockey India League games between **2012 and 2015.**
 
• For the first time, India will play host to the** Asian Champions Trophy women's hockey** competition in Ranchi. 
 
 
 
• **West Bengal** has hosted several international sports events such as the** FIFA U-17 World Cup** and the** Kolkata Marathon.**
